Measuring almond flour

Finely ground blanched almond flour weighs about 112 g per cup, based on the ¼ cup = 28 g serving on most bags. Almond meal, which is coarser and made with the skins on, usually weighs a little less per cup because it doesn't settle as tightly. King Arthur's chart lists 96 g, measured very lightly.

Almond flour isn't a one-for-one swap for wheat flour. It has no gluten and much more fat, so recipes built for it use different ratios. Use the weight here to follow almond flour recipes accurately, not to substitute it into regular ones.

Source: Bob's Red Mill Super-Fine Almond Flour label (¼ cup = 28 g); King Arthur Baking lists 96 g.

Questions

How many grams is ½ cup of almond flour?

½ cup of almond flour weighs about 56 g (1.98 oz). A full cup is 112 g.

How many cups is 100 grams of almond flour?

100 g of almond flour is ⅞ cup, based on 112 g per cup.

Can I replace all-purpose flour with almond flour?

Not cup for cup. Almond flour has no gluten and a lot more fat, so cakes and breads made with a straight swap come out dense and crumbly. Use recipes written for almond flour, and measure it by weight (about 112 g per cup).
